proposition.headline: You do not employ the people selling your cars. Can you see whether they have switched on.
proposition.evidenceHook: XPENG runs 290 stores across 28 European countries and every disclosed market goes through a partner, agent, distributor or franchised dealer. The UK is International Motors. Adoption against target, per region, down to a named person, is the demo's central screen.
proposition.notUsed: The 22% Alexander Wass uplift. Melissa has already seen it, and repeating a credential to the person who is already convinced wastes the seconds that belong to the person who is not.

programme.name: XPENG Vector
programme.reasoning: A vector carries magnitude and direction. A bonus scheme only carries magnitude, so it makes the network do more of whatever it already does; this programme pays for test drives, order conversion, certification and demonstrator availability rather than raw volume, so the name states what the mechanic actually does. It also reads as native to a brand that builds aircraft and robots alongside cars, and it carries across the build's five languages unchanged. Names the people's work rather than a vehicle outcome, which was the recorded flaw in Geely Uptime.
